### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Very High |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium-High — UK critical / discursive tradition |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | UK / European social psychology — social identity theory (Tajfel, Turner), discursive psychology (Edwards, Potter), critical-realist social psychology, intergroup relations |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **UK / European social-psychology contribution** — SIT, discursive analysis, critical-realist framings welcomed alongside experimental work.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Pure US individualist redirected to JESP / PSPB.

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Pure US individualist social-cognition without UK/European framing
- AI use without disclosure per Wiley/BPS policy
- Manuscripts ignoring European social-psychology tradition

### Soft Tax

Low for UK / European social-psychology tradition. US authors may need broader theoretical engagement.

### Best Suited For

- Social identity theory empirical work
- Discursive psychology research
- Critical-realist social-psychology
- Intergroup relations
- Collective action
- Qualitative social-psychology

### Not Recommended For

- Pure US individualist social-cognition (consider JESP, PSPB)
- Pure psychological measurement (consider J Personality Assessment)

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [European Journal of Social Psychology](./european-journal-of-social-psychology.md) | EASP peer; broader European focus |
| 2 | [Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin](./personality-and-social-psychology-bulletin.md) | If US-friendly reframe possible |
| 3 | [Journal of Applied Social Psychology](./journal-of-applied-social-psychology.md) | If applied focus |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from JPSP as "too critical / discursive," BJSP is the BPS home for UK social psychology.
